children: Colombia has identified nearly 165 investment projects worth more than 290 trillion pesos ($92.23 billion) to pitch to investors, Vice President Jose Manuel Restrepo said on Friday.
Through these projects, the government aims to lift investment to the equivalent of 25% of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2030, Restrepo said.
